meta.notes: A maple hanging sign: under a block it hangs on two chains (on one bar when the block above is too narrow), and placed against a side it becomes the generated wall hanging sign msm_starter:maple_hanging_sign_wall on a bracket. Its board is drawn from the stripped log; the writing screen shows textures/gui/hanging_signs/maple_hanging_sign.png, which the flow saves. It stacks to 16.
